create_dnc_core: create a DNC core module with an LSTM controller and configurable memory access module
build_dnc_initial_state: build the initial DNCState with zeroed access output and initialized controller and access states
run_dnc_forward_pass: run the DNC forward pass by concatenating inputs with access output and passing through the LSTM controller
review_dnc_clip_value: review the DNC core clip_value parameter to control output value clipping between negative and positive bounds
test_dnc_state_size: test the DNC core state_size property to verify access output, access state, and controller state dimensions
